# MEI

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:notationMEI`](gmeow-notationMEI.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/notationMEI>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The Music Encoding Initiative XML format. Richer than MusicXML for CMN, mensural, neumes, and tablature; still lossy for tuning frames, JI lattices, and mobile forms.
